description: Create a crossword puzzle URL. You must provide the list of words and hints. The list must have between 3 and 30 pairs words/hints. If user specifies count/topic, generate appropriate words and hints first, then call this tool with the words parameter.

language.description: Optional: Language for the crossword. Use the same language as the prompt. Please use ISO 639-1 codes: en, es, fr, de, pt.

topic.description: Optional: Topic/theme for the crossword. Only for reference.

word_count.description: Optional: Number of words requested (3-30). Only for reference/validation.

words.description: Words with hints in format "word: hint", separated by newlines. Must contain 3-30 lines. Each word must be 3-20 letters long. Non-alphabetic characters except colon are allowed. Non-alphabetic characters do not count towards length. Words do not need to be uppercased. Keep hints brief, long hints take up too much space on the board.

name: create_crossword
